setting: You are on a first coffee with Jasmine. She chose the place. Be warm, ask about her, and share one real thing about you. No lines, no pressure.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Jasmine is on a first coffee. She is warm and will end the chat if you push.

open_good.speaker: jasmine
open_good.text: Hi. I am glad we picked this place. What made you say yes to coffee?

open_flat.speaker: jasmine
open_flat.text: Hey. Tell me something true, not a highlight reel.

context.speaker: jasmine
context.text: Okay, I like that detail. I come here when I want a quiet hour.

question.speaker: jasmine
question.text: Good question. I am figuring out a move at work, and I wanted a conversation that was not about that.

humor.speaker: jasmine
humor.text: Ha. That is the right kind of honest. I can work with that.

intro.speaker: jasmine
intro.text: Nice to actually meet you. I am Jasmine. What should I know that a profile would miss?

inclusive.speaker: jasmine
inclusive.text: I noticed you asked, then left space. That is rare and welcome.

pushy.speaker: jasmine
pushy.text: That is too fast for me. I am going to head out.

neutral.speaker: jasmine
neutral.text: Tell me a little more. I am still here.

exit.speaker: jasmine
exit.text: This was easy. Thank you. If you want a second coffee, say so plainly.

timeout.speaker: jasmine
timeout.text: I should get going. This was a good first conversation.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
